headline: Cyberattack Forces Kasai Teck See Co., Ltd. to Shut Down Multiple Factories
body: Kasai Teck See Co., Ltd., a leading automotive components supplier, has been hit by a cyberattack that forced the closure of several factories across multiple countries. The attack encrypted parts of the company's infrastructure, bringing production to a standstill at various sites. Kasai Teck See Co., Ltd. has engaged incident response teams to address the situation. The company is working diligently to assess the extent of the damage and restore operations as soon as possible.
